title: Remote workbench
description: Use a browser to inspect and control the host over LAN or VPN. USB acquisition runs on the host.
desktopRequired: Open the desktop app to enable the remote service.
lanHint: Listen on all IPv4 interfaces. Use your host’s LAN or VPN address.
urlHint: Use the exact root URL visitors will open. For VPN, enter the host’s VPN IP. Default port: 10532.
sharedHint: Markers are shared with the desktop and other browsers.
captureHint: One acquisition at a time. Closing the browser keeps acquisition running.
restartHint: Applying settings creates a new access code and disconnects all browsers. The service starts manually each time SigPilot opens.
connectHint: Open the address on another computer, then enter the access code below. Keep the host app running.
authorizationHint: Share the code with trusted users. Browser authorization lasts 8 hours; revoke individual browsers below. LAN HTTP is intended for a trusted network or encrypted VPN.
loginHint: Enter the access code from the host’s Remote workbench panel.
empty: Open a capture on the host, import a .pxl file, or start acquisition.
viewHint: Scroll to zoom · drag to pan · right click to mark a sample. Your viewport is independent.
noMeasurement: No bounded pulse at this sample.
noRows: No matching frames. Check the protocol parameters.
acquireLimit: First release: digital acquisition, up to 64 MiB / 60 seconds, without waiting for a trigger.
permissionMissing: The host has not allowed this action.
precision: This capture exceeds browser coordinate precision. Export it for desktop analysis.
fileLimit: Imports must be .pxl files up to 32 MiB.
retryHint: If edits conflict, refresh and retry.
